messages:
sean: Heads-up: deploy-bot paused the promote for release v6.0.0 during the change window. CI run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/400404 — reason: artifact store 5xx on fetch + integration tests 4/12 failing. :warning:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: reason=artifact_fetch_5xx+test_failures, artifact=backend-service@sha256:77aa33bb, auto_retries=2
sean: tail of failing logs:
```
ERROR storage: blob fetch failed with 503 from s3-registry-us-west-2
ERROR integration:test_payment_flow: assertion failed: expected status 200 got 502
ERROR integration:test_user_sync: timeout waiting for webhook callback (30s)
```
maya: Looks like two separate issues: transient storage 503 (could be region S3 hiccup) and at least two real integration failures (payment_flow and user_sync) which may be app regressions. Change window ends in 28m.
devops-lead: Options: (1) short hold 5m for storage retry then re-run smoke only (cheap), (2) manual-pin to last-known-good to preserve window, (3) abort promote and rollback plan/patch now (if regression confirmed), (4) full rerun (likely miss window). We need risk appetite from product.
product-release: If failures are real regressions (payment_flow), we cannot ship. Pinning would avoid regression but keeps old behavior. We need a quick triage: are the integration failures environment flakes or code regressions?
ravi: I'll triage test failures now. Quick grep shows stacktrace pointing to change in payment client timeout increase introduced in the last commit. That seems like a code regression, not infra.
sean: if ravi confirms regression, then we should not promote. Two choices: rollback to prior artifact (manual pin) and open hotfix for the regression, or block and rerun CI after hotfix. Which preserves safety and policy?
security-bot: Note: any promote must pass integration gates for payment-related tests per compliance policy COM-INT-03.
devops-lead: Given security/compliance and triage pointing to regression, my recommendation: do NOT promote this artifact. Manual-pin to previous stable to keep change window and avoid shipping the regression, and start hotfix branch for the failing commit. We'll also create a postmortem TKT and tag infra for the 503. Need approver from product-release. @product-release?
product-release: I agree — do not promote. Manual-pin previous artifact and annotate release notes: "Promotion halted due to regression in payment_flow integration test; pinned to previous artifact while hotfix is developed." Also schedule hotfix branch and patch PR.
ravi: Creating HOTFIX-6312: "Fix payment client timeout regression causing integration failure" and TKT-6313: "Investigate S3-registry 503 during promote". Assigning eng and infra respectively.
maya: Action items: (1) block re-promote until hotfix passes full CI, (2) schedule quick debug session for S3 503 (could be unrelated), (3) update release notes with pin and tickets.
product-release: I'll update the release draft and notify customers who were targeted for this change window. Also mark the release as "pinned due to regression" in the release tracker.
sean: Window unblocked. I'll keep monitoring HOTFIX-6312 progress and will re-open promote thread when we have a green build. Closing this thread for now. :lock: :rocket:
sean: command I'll run: `deployctl promote --artifact backend-service@sha256:44ee99aa --target=stable --reason "regression in integration tests; avoid shipping" --annotate "manual pin; follow-up HOTFIX-6312 & TKT-6313"`
deploy-bot: Promotion executed by sean. stable -> backend-service@sha256:44ee99aa. Note added to release metadata.
